entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Ah... This bears the exact same decoration[n]as the door that blocks the great stairs.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So what, does that mean we ain't gonna[n]be able to open it?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: No, I think it's the opposite. How we[n]open this door should provide a hint[n]for unlocking the other one.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We might find something out if we[n]investigate the area around here![n]Let's go, everyone!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Come on, we need to try and find a way[n]to open this door!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What's this thing, some kinda button?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Think before you go touching that, okay?[n]It might be a trap. Although, I'm curious[n]about it myself...
Let's press it.
We should leave it alone.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: As they say, "Nothing ventured, nothing[n]gained." Very well.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Okay. Let's reconsider our options and[n]determine if this is truly our only choice[n]here.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Holy crap, that scared the shit outta me![n]It totally WAS a trap!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I'm not so sure about that... It looks[n]like pressing that button has changed[n]something in here.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Yes, there is now light being cast on that[n]door. It is a markedly obvious difference.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You're right. Let's go take a closer look.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hm, this may be a button of some kind.[n]Should we press it, Joker?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh, hey! It's open!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: So, shining light upon the door is what[n]caused it to unlock...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wait, doesn't that mean we can open[n]the door at the great stairs the same[n]way!?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That's a definite possibility. In any case,[n]we should push on.
